title: RudderStack Destination Freshness SLA
app: RudderStack delivery and failed-events metrics via the RudderStack API to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=rudderstack:delivery status="delivered"
| stats latest(_time) as last_success by destination_name
| eval hours_stale=round((now()-last_success)/3600,1)
| where hours_stale>6
| sort - hours_stale
description: Tracks the last successful update of each RudderStack destination and flags those that have not refreshed within their freshness window, catching stale data even when no job reports a failure.
value: A destination can go stale without any error (a paused schedule, a missed trigger); freshness-SLA monitoring closes that blind spot for RudderStack.
implementation: Ingest RudderStack success events; schedule hourly and alert when a critical destination exceeds its freshness window.
visualization: Table of destination by hours stale, freshness heat map.
grandmaExplanation: We check that each part of RudderStack has updated recently so nobody relies on old data.
